skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts of natural resource economics.
Analyze the economic efficiency of natural resource exploitation activities.
Understand economic models of natural resource exploitation.
Understand economic tools and policies for sustainable natural resource management.
Apply knowledge to analyze economic issues in natural resource management.
Work independently and in groups to solve economic problems in natural resource management.
Develop skills in presenting and discussing economic analysis of natural resources.
Develop the ability to self-study and work independently.
Develop the ability to take responsibility and work in a team.
